name: dms-monorepo

scripts.build:all: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && npm run build
scripts.migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma db seed
scripts.setup: npm install && cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed

postinstall: cd packages/inventory-calculations && npm run build 2>/dev/null || true
